description: Form 8582 line 6 instructions: modified AGI does not take into account 'The deduction allowed for the deductible part of self-employment taxes'. Schedule C profit $120,000 and nothing else: AGI before the rental is 120,000 less the ½-SE deduction, and modified AGI adds it back to $120,000, so line 8 = 50% x (150,000 − 120,000) = $15,000 of a $20,000 actively managed rental loss; $5,000 carried over.
